analysis: Documentation-only change in docs/architecture/inference.md. The supplied base units (lines 819-1618) are unchanged context. The patch excerpt adds head lines 619-625 and 869-905. Lines 619-625 state that freshness in EnginePerformanceMeasurements.Rate is anchored to the newest observation, so an out-of-order receipt cannot move freshness backward. Lines 869-905 describe TTFT admission estimator corrections: decode is charged per batch step using CBv2DecodeRateShape, and DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES=0 restores the previous estimators. The changed lines are in AdmissionRateEstimators.swift territory and concern availability and deadline-admission accuracy only. They do not change the encryption, attestation, authorization, cache scoping (T-041/SEC-035) or billing boundaries. The deadline catalog remains empty (base line 885), so qualified-profile behavior is unaffected. One residual is possible new DoS/latency drift from less conservative decode pricing. This is an availability estimate, not a security control, so no finding is raised. The Swift implementation was not supplied. The base line 1723 removal and head line 1767 change were not visible in the supplied units. The integration pass could check whether the new DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES variable is covered by DeadlineRuntimeEnvironment.permitsQualification, which rejects performance-affecting DARKBLOOM_* settings (base line 891).
